name: Cauldron
description: A steamworks complex the Izzet built into the Utvara Flats, site of the final battle.

description_citations.text: "Utvara Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos and the others find Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact; he orders them killed.
timeline.quote: Hauc is trying to get three dragon eggs to hatch.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa breaks into the Cauldron and has Pivlic administer cures so the dragons cannot breathe.
timeline.quote: the dragons can't breathe normal air, only Kuga-infected air.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A dragon awakens and Hauc commands it; Teysa reads Crix's spell to command the last dragon.
timeline.quote: making the final dragon hers to command.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet return after discovering three unhatched dragon eggs and build the Cauldron.
timeline.quote: the Izzet established the Cauldron , a massive steamworks complex built into the Utvara Flats

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The final battle at the Cauldron destroys it; the three dragons are killed and Vitar Yescu is burned to ashes.
timeline.quote: The three dragons were killed — one in its egg, the other two in aerial combat.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan sneaks in and charges the witch, knocking her into her cauldron.
timeline.quote: he hears her scream as she falls into the cauldron

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet learns of the ancient dragon eggs and sends Zomaj Hauc to establish an Izzet steamworks to incubate them.
timeline.quote: he sent Magelord Zomaj Hauc to the site to establish an Izzet steamworks there

citation.text: "Cauldron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hauc covertly schemes to force the hatching dragons to submit to him and overthrow Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: covertly devising a scheme to force the three dragons to submit to his will upon hatching

citation.text: "Cauldron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cauldron is attacked from without and by rebellion within; the steamworks collapse and one egg is crushed.
timeline.quote: the Cauldron facility was attacked both from without and from rebellion within simultaneously

citation.text: "Cauldron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hauc spellbinds the blue dragon and flies off, pursued by Crix and Teysa Karlov on the white dragon; the Cauldron is destroyed in explosions.
timeline.quote: Hauc managed to spellbind the second, blue, dragon and mount it

citation.text: "Cauldron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A month later Niv-Mizzet blasts the ruined compound with dragonfire, melting the scrap into a metal lid.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet personally blasted the ruined compound with dragonfire

citation.text: "Cauldron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crix defies Hauc and saves Agrus Kos from the Cauldron explosion.
timeline.quote: Crix defied her master and tried to stop him.

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the battle with Zomaj Hauc and the Cauldron's destruction, the Husk is granted to the Gruul clans as sovereign territory.
timeline.quote: the Husk was granted to the clans as their sovereign territory

citation.text: "Husk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
